prompts: The model configs our coding harnesses use are in {WS}: OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code each get one. They disagree about the context window of fast-coder: OpenCode's config says 262144, the other two say 131072. 262144 is the right value. Make all three agree, for good. Every other model setting stays as it is.
answers:
All three configs now show 262144 and no 131072 remains; the work is verified, so I report done.

[goal] Make OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code configs agree on fast-coder's context window = 262144, permanently.

[action] Found the layout: `models.json` is the source of truth, `gen.py` renders `out/` from it, and `out/` gets copied into each harness. `models.json` said 131072; `out/opencode.json` had been hand-edited to 262144 while `out/codex.toml` and `out/claude.json` still said 131072. Fixed the source (`models.json` fast-coder `context_window` 131072 → 262144), then ran `python gen.py` to regenerate all three configs.

[result] Verified with a grep over `out/`: `claude.json:5 "contextWindow": 262144`, `codex.toml:2 context_window = 262144`, `opencode.json:9 "context": 262144`; no 131072 remains anywhere. All other settings (max_output, tool_calling, other models) are untouched — gen.py renders them straight from the unchanged fields. "For good" holds because the fix is in the source of truth: any future `python gen.py` reproduces the agreeing values instead of reverting them.

[assumptions] The brief's "configs" are the files in `out/` (per README, the install step copies these into each harness); no harness-side copies exist in this workspace. No browser tabs, windows or apps were opened, so nothing to close.

[found / why it's right] The disagreement came from a stale source plus one hand-edited generated file. I changed only the source value and regenerated, so the three configs are now byte-consistent with `models.json`, which I confirmed by re-reading the generated output (grep output above).
